title: config: KITH_DB_PATH bare-filename edge case untested
description: resolve_data_dir() has a guard 'if parent \!= Path::new("")' to handle the case where KITH_DB_PATH is a bare filename with no directory component (e.g. 'kith.db'), which would produce an empty parent and incorrectly become data_dir. This guard is subtly correct but there is no test covering it. The backward-compat code path (KITH_DB_PATH) has tests for the happy path but not for the bare-filename degenerate case, leaving the guard unvalidated.
